name: 西游记2000
group_note: 西游记2000 (Journey to the West 2000), a classic MudOS-era mudlib themed around Journey to the West, with an in-flow 'are you a school-age student' age-gate question that's original design, not a bug. WASM pass fixed 3 chained bugs: (1) adm/daemons/convertd.lpc's GB/BIG5 conversion table (inittable) had the same byte-level corruption pattern as the sjsh-family libs (symbols packed together instead of one per array element) -- fixed with the standard per-codepoint resplitting script (~45 lines affected). (2) adm/daemons/network/dns_master.lpc, a genuinely multi-purpose intermud daemon (query_mud_name()/muds mapping called by ~28 other service files: mudlist_a/mudlist_q/gtell/gchannel/rwho/etc) -- per AGENTS.md §7.52's exception for multi-purpose daemons, did NOT disable the whole file; only gutted the two socket-touching entry points (startup_udp() now returns 0, matching its own existing failure-return convention so create()'s 'if (startup_udp()) init_database();' naturally skips socket-dependent init; send_udp() now a no-op) plus removed one straggling socket_close() in send_shutdown(). (3) A chained bug this exposed: adm/etc/preload had the dns_master line commented out (enabled in the original raw archive; likely someone's pre-existing workaround to let the mudlib boot at all before the socket-compat fix existed), so DNS_MASTER was never preloaded. adm/daemons/logind.lpc's encoding() checks 'if(!find_object(DNS_MASTER) || ...) shutdown(1);' right after encoding selection -- find_object() only returns true for already-loaded objects, so with the daemon never preloaded this check was always true, and shutdown(1) fired on literally every connection immediately after GB/BIG5 selection, leaving the connection with no further input_to() registered (all subsequent input showed as unrecognized commands). Root-caused via reading logind.lpc's encoding() and confirming the preload line was disabled while the raw archive had it active; fixed by re-enabling the preload line now that dns_master.lpc compiles and runs cleanly under WASM -- no change needed to logind.lpc's own check. Admin seeded: fluffos (admin) in adm/etc/wizlist (securityd.lpc genuinely reads WIZLIST at boot). Registration flow verified end-to-end in one continuous WASM client session: GB/BIG5 select -> no (age gate) -> new -> English id -> Chinese name -> password + confirm -> email -> gender (m/f) -> stat-allocation menu (9 to accept defaults, y to confirm) -> enters world with full character sheet; look/score/quit all clean. Admin permission directly confirmed via '目前权限：(admin)' on login. LPC formatter run across all 5637 .lpc files (5542 written, 4 refused as pre-existing unterminated-string/textblock content bugs unrelated to formatting, 91 unchanged). No :: parent-call split hits, no CJK-respacing hits, no case-label-with-trailing-comment candidates in the pre-format blobs of changed files. Post-formatter re-verified with the same full registration flow -- clean, admin permission still (admin). RETROACTIVE follow-up after scripts/scan_known_bugs.py (a new static scanner built this session) flagged 5 lazy-loaded/latent bugs the original registration-only smoke test never triggered: d/obj/books-nonskill/book-qujing.lpc's absolute #include </d/qujing/obstacle.h> (never resolves, quoted instead); logind.lpc's check_legal_name() had the standard §8.1 i%2 parity gate + [i..<0] suffix slice (harmless here only because this lib's is_chinese() happens to just check str[0], but fixed to the standard per-codepoint form for consistency/robustness); master.lpc's valid_read()/valid_write() forwarded straight to SECURITY_D with no 'user == this_object()' guard (the same latent risk that silently killed every new-player-body compile on sibling xyj20032 -- not observed to fire here, fixed proactively); 3 files called is_killing(me) with an object where feature/attack.lpc declares is_killing(string id) (§7.50, daemon/class/dragon/dragonforce/roar.lpc, daemon/class/yaomo/kusong/huomo/fire.lpc, cmds/std/surrender.lpc); d/sky/npc/zz-tianwang.lpc still had raw GBK bytes the original conversion pass missed (iconv'd). Also found and fixed adm/simul_efun/message.lpc's tell_room() forwarding an unset exclude straight into message()'s 4th arg (§7.12, exclude || ({})). Re-verified clean post-fix.
